name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-search-budget
description: Cost budget for dsh web_search: bounds the number of billable provider search requests a `web_search` call may initiate (per call / per turn / per session / whole subagent tree) and denies the call with an actionable error once the budget is exhausted. Exists because `tool-web.searchMaxQueries` bounds only the model-supplied query array while `web-search-deepseek.maxUses` bounds only the server-side searches inside one request — the product of the two per query, plus unbounded subagent fan-out, is what makes a single session issue hundreds of billable requests. Compatible with dsh 0.1.5-alpha.1+.
